run_mephisto_config_read: read the full mephisto config or a specific section.key value from the config file
run_mephisto_config_write: set a mephisto config value by specifying a section.key identifier and the new value
run_mephisto_check: check that mephisto is set up correctly by verifying the local database and mock requester
run_mephisto_list_requesters: list all registered requesters in the mephisto database and display them in a table
run_mephisto_register_provider: register a new requester with a crowd provider by passing the provider type and required arguments
